# Contribution workflow

All contributions must follow: new branch -> pull request -> approval.

- Create a new branch for each contribution; do not commit project changes directly to the default branch.
- Push the contribution branch and open a pull request.
- Use a draft pull request for incomplete progress.
- Wait for approval before merging. Do not merge or bypass review requirements without explicit authorization.
- Preserve unrelated work and run the relevant checks before submitting changes.
